description: A list's distinct items follow pushes and shifts in first-occurrence order
code:
visits = ["lab", "den", "lab", "hall"]
rooms = visits.distinct()
visits.push("den")
visits.push("attic")
assert(rooms, ["lab", "den", "hall", "attic"])
visits.shift()
rooms

description: A selector lists each property value once over every instance of a class
code:
class Order(region):
    this.region = region
Order("north")
Order("south")
Order("north")
regions = Order.distinct(order -> order.region)
Order("east")
regions

description: Distinct values are compared without conversion and null matches undefined
code:
values = [1, "1", true, 1, null, "1"]
values.push(values[99])
kinds = values.distinct()
[kinds.length, values.length, kinds]

description: Records with the same contents are one value while instances stay apart
code:
class Robot(name):
    this.name = name
ada = Robot("ada")
twin = Robot("ada")
spots = [{x: 1, y: 2}, {y: 2, x: 1}, {x: 2, y: 1}]
[spots.distinct().length, [ada, twin, ada].distinct().length]

description: A class-level rule keeps the distinct regions of each customer
code:
class Customer(name):
    this.name = name
class Order(customer, region):
    this.customer = customer
    this.region = region
$Customer.regions = Order.filter(order -> order.customer == $Customer).distinct(order -> order.region)
ada = Customer("ada")
Order(ada, "north")
Order(ada, "south")
Order(ada, "north")
ada.regions

description: The distinct tags of every post stay live as posts and tags change
code:
class Post(tags):
    this.tags = tags
first = Post(["rust", "logic"])
Post(["logic", "go"])
inuse = Post.flatMap(post -> post.tags).distinct()
first.tags.push("go")
Post(["sql"])
inuse

description: Every NaN is kept because NaN matches no value
A distinct selector that is not a function raises a TypeError
code:
failure = ""
try:
    [1, 2].distinct(5)
catch error:
    failure = error
failure

description: Predicate counts keep each team's open jobs and matching list items live
code:
class Team(name): this.name = name
class Job(team, done):
    this.team = team
    this.done = done
$Team.open = Job.count(job -> job.team == $Team and not job.done)
team = Team("north")
first = Job(team, false)
Job(team, true)
values = [1, 4, 7]
large = values.count(value -> value > 3)
assert(team.open, 1)
first.done = true
values.push(9)
[team.open, large]
